name: Behavioral Discovery & User Segmentation
description: Methods for discovering and defining target behaviors: Target Outcome vs Action, Actor profiling, Personas, Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD), behavioral clustering, and dynamic intent state modeling.

subskills.name: Product Clarification & Value Scope
subskills.description: Articulating the core value proposition and boundary scope of the product.

subskills.name: User Personas & Empathy Mapping
subskills.description: Creating evidence-based personas, empathy maps, and behavioral archetypes.

subskills.name: Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD) Theory
subskills.description: Formulating JTBD statements: Situation -> Motivation -> Desired Outcome.

subskills.name: Target Outcome Definition & Metrics
subskills.description: Defining the measurable business and user outcomes the product aims to achieve.

subskills.name: Target Actor & Stakeholder Profiling
subskills.description: Identifying the specific individual or stakeholder who must perform the target action.

subskills.name: Target Action Specification & Granularity
subskills.description: Defining specific, observable, and measurable target actions (when, where, how).

subskills.name: Behavioral Segmentation & Quantitative Clustering
subskills.description: Segmenting users by usage patterns, frequency, and friction points rather than purely demographic attributes.

subskills.name: Multi-Sided Platform Actor Ecosystems
subskills.description: Mapping interconnected behaviors in multi-sided platforms (e.g. buyers, sellers, admins).

subskills.name: Dynamic Intent State Modeling
subskills.description: Modeling dynamic user intent transitions (exploratory, goal-directed, transactional, disengaged).

github.signal: Persona profiles, JTBD job maps, and behavioral segmentation models in design docs

cv.signal: Conducted user research formulating JTBD frameworks, behavioral personas, and target action specifications
Designed multi-sided platform actor ecosystems and implemented behavioral clustering with dynamic intent modeling

linkedin.signal: Endorsements in User Personas, Jobs-to-be-Done (JTBD), Behavioral Research, and Customer Discovery

assessment.signal: Passes behavioral classification assessment covering JTBD statements, target action definitions, behavioral clustering, and multi-sided actor ecosystems

junior.description: Articulates core product value, creates evidence-based personas, and writes JTBD job statements.

mid.description: Defines discrete target actions, profiles target actors, and sets measurable outcome metrics.

senior.description: Executes quantitative behavioral segmentation, maps multi-sided marketplace ecosystems, and models dynamic intent states.
